name: payables_vendor_outstanding_summary_aggregate_explain
sql_start:
SELECT
            vendor_id,
            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN outstanding_asof > 0 THEN outstanding_asof ELSE 0 END), 0) AS positive_outstanding,
            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN outstanding_asof < 0 THEN ABS(outstanding_asof) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS credit_balance,
            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN outstanding_asof > 0 AND reference_date > '2026-10-10'::date THEN outstanding_asof ELSE 0 END), 0) AS not_due,
            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN outstanding_asof > 0 AND reference_date <= '2026-10-10'::date THEN outstanding_asof ELSE 0 END), 0) AS overdue_amount,
            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN outstanding_asof > 0 AND reference_date < '2026-10-10'::date AND reference_date >= '2026-09-10'::date THEN outstanding_asof ELSE 0 END), 0) AS bucket_0_30,
            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN outstanding_asof > 0 AND reference_date < '2026-09-10'::date AND reference_date >= '2026-08-11'::date THEN outstanding_asof ELSE 0 END), 0) AS bucket_31_60,
            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN outstanding_asof > 0 AND reference_date < '2026-08-11'::date AND reference_date >= '2026-07-12'::date THEN outstanding_asof ELSE 0 END), 0) AS bucket_61_90,
            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN outstanding_asof > 0 AND reference_date < '2026-07-12'::date AND reference_date >= '2026-04-13'::date THEN outstanding_asof ELSE 0 END), 0) AS bucket_91_180,
            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN outstanding_asof > 0 AND reference_date < '2026-04-13'::date THEN outstanding_asof ELSE 0 END), 0) AS bucket_181_plus,
            MIN(CASE WHEN outstanding_asof > 0 AND reference_date <= '2026-10-10'::date THEN reference_date ELSE NULL END) AS oldest_due_date
        FROM (
            SELECT
                oi.id,
                oi.vendor_id,
                COALESCE(oi.due_date, oi.bill_date) AS reference_date,
                COALESCE(oi.outstanding_amount, 0) AS outstanding_asof
            FROM purchase_vendorbillopenitem oi
            INNER JOIN purchase_purchaseinvoiceheader hdr ON hdr.id = oi.header_id
